intent: Caption the control of a Field, as the kit Label styled for the Field layout.
typical_uses: The caption of a Field's control, associated with it via htmlFor

dont_use_when.situation: A caption for a control outside any Field composition
A title that names no control, inside a FieldContent

invariants.text: FieldLabel renders the kit Label (a native label element) with its width shrunk to its content, so every Label behaviour holds, including that it adds no association of its own: htmlFor pointing at the control's id is set by the consumer.

Inside a Field carrying data-disabled="true" it is dimmed to the disabled opacity, and inside a Field carrying data-invalid="true" it inherits the --danger text color. As a direct child of a horizontal Field it grows to fill the row.

anti_patterns.dont: Leave htmlFor off and expect the Field to connect the caption
anti_patterns.do_instead: Pass htmlFor naming the control's id; nothing in the family wires it

a11y.by: field.test.tsx asserts that getByLabelText("Email") finds the Input whose id the FieldLabel's htmlFor names

good.title: A caption associated with its control

bad.title: A caption prop the component does not have
bad.why: FieldLabel forwards the native label attributes and declares none of its own - there is no label prop. The caption is children.
